![](images/05/05a5ef716cefc08eb68857a5339565e8aa71109f3b69773057beaaa194a5cf20.png)

Which of the following sets of parametric equations, defined for $θ ∈ [0, 2π)$, generate the ellipse shown above?
worked_solution:
The diagram shows an ellipse centered at the origin, with horizontal radius $3$ and vertical radius $5$. A parametrization is

$$
x=3\cos\theta,\qquad y=5\sin\theta,\qquad0\le\theta<2\pi.
$$

Indeed, these coordinates satisfy $x^2/9+y^2/25=1$ and trace the entire ellipse. Swapping the radii would produce a horizontally stretched ellipse.
